artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne
artworks.artist: Per Gustaf Floding
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with figures in dramatic poses. The image shows two central figures and a cherub in the background against a cloudy backdrop in shades of brown.

artworks.title: Guardhouse
artworks.artist: Per Gustaf Floding, after François Boucher
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a cluttered room with various objects and draped fabrics scattered throughout. The painting features soft textiles, framed artworks or mirrors, and a hanging lantern. The scene captures a moment of rest amidst numerous items, each draped or positioned haphazardly. The intricate details and interplay of light and shadow create a sense of depth and dimension in the composition. The color palette consists of warm sepia tones, giving a vintage and timeless atmosphere. The style resembles François Boucher, known for ornamental and detailed depictions of Rococo elegance.

artworks.title: Blason de la Ville de Paris (Arms of the City of Paris)
artworks.artist: Per Gustaf Floding, after Simon Challes
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms. The central focus of the drawing is a representation of the coat of arms of the city of Paris, depicted within an ornamental frame. The image features a stylized ship on waves, surrounded by a draped fabric patterned with fleur-de-lis motifs. Below the illustration, there are inscriptions in French providing context and credit to the creator, noting it as the 'Blason de la Ville de Paris.' The technique used in this drawing gives it an intricate and classical appearance, reminiscent of traditional heraldic art.

artworks.title: Persée et Andromede (Perseus and Andromeda)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint  with roulette and burnishing printed in brown-black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 34.5 × 47.8 cm (13 9/16 × 18 13/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 40.6 × 50.7 cm (16 × 19 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The scene shows a figure with a sword and shield descending from the sky, confronting another figure on a rocky outcrop. Waves crash against rocks below. In the background, a group of observers can be seen. The drawing uses shading and line work for depth.

artworks.title: Décolation de St. Jean (Beheading of Saint John the Baptist)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Nikolaus Knüpfer (formerly after Giovanni Francesco Barbieri, called Guercino)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals in a dramatic scene. A woman stands in the center holding a platter, with detailed features, an elaborate headdress, and a voluminous dress. Next to her, a figure supports her from behind while another kneels on the ground. A semi-nude man is contorted and a severed head lies nearby. In the background, a soldier in armor stands holding a spear near an archway. The scene is sketched in chiaroscuro style, depicting an interior with arched doors.

artworks.title: Descent from the Cross
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette printed in black on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from a religious artwork showing the body of a man being lowered from a wooden cross. The full length of the man is visible, suggesting a depiction of the man being taken down from the crucifix. Positioned centrally, the man is supported by three other men. Two of these men are positioned on ladders, in the process of aiding the descent, while the third is standing on the ground assisting in the process. The man has long hair and a beard, and his body appears limp as he is gently lowered. He is barely clothed, with a cloth draped around his waist. The individuals assisting in the descent wear long, flowing garments, typical of historical or biblical attire. Surrounding them, there are several women, all with their heads covered, praying and observing the scene in various postures, with some kneeling. The background features a barren landscape with a few more crosses visible, adding a somber tone to the scene. The sky is overcast, lending a muted atmosphere to the composition, and a skull is present on the ground near the base of the cross, highlighting the theme of mortality.

artworks.title: Descent from the Cross
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with multiple figures involved. The image shows a lifeless body being lowered from a large wooden cross by a group of individuals. The figures are clothed in flowing garments, conveying a moment of mourning and solemnity. There is a ladder leaning against the cross with individuals positioned on and around it. On the ground, a skull and bones are visible. The background includes a cloudy sky and an additional pair of crosses. The drawing evokes a sense of drama and emotion through its use of shading and composition.

artworks.title: Descente de Croix (Descent from the Cross)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Carle Van Loo, published by Pierre-François Basan
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several people centered around the removal of a figure from a cross. The central figure, lifeless, is being lowered from the cross by individuals with a ladder beside them. The central figure has distinct features with closed eyes and is draped in a cloth, with long hair falling loosely. Surrounding this, people in robes are helping to lower the body. The scene is set against a dark sky and barren landscape, with additional crosses in the background.

artworks.title: Rape of Europa
artworks.artist: Nicolas Le Sueur, after Paolo Farinati
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in green and brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures and a bull in a mythical scene. The central figure is seated on top of the bull, with other figures interacting around them. Another figure is depicted flying or diving in the sky. Stylized trees and clouds are in the background, with delicate, flowing lines. The precise line work adds movement and drama to the composition. Soft tones are used to create a classical and serene atmosphere, highlighting the elegance of the figures and animals.

artworks.title: Rape of Europa
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Nicolas Le Sueur, after Paolo Farinati
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This image is a depiction of a mythological scene featuring figures, trees, and a creature. The central figure is seated on a creature, possibly a bull, surrounded by other figures. Detailed foliage of trees forms the backdrop. Another figure above is in motion, adding dynamism to the composition. The lines are fluid, and shading adds depth and texture to emphasize forms and clothing. The style shows classical influences with a focus on form and movement, possibly inspired by mythology.

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.artist: Nicolas Le Sueur
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in green and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two central figures. One figure, a man, is shown reclining against some drapery. He appears to be asleep, with his head resting on his hand and eyes closed. His long hair cascades past his shoulders. He is partially covered by a piece of cloth draped over his lower body and is holding a staff or rod with one hand. Another figure, a woman, is positioned behind him, looking down at him. Her hair is styled in an updo, with some decorative detail. She is wearing a flowing garment that leaves her arms bare. Two cherub-like figures hover above them, holding a torch, while two dogs lie at the man's feet. The background features swirling lines suggesting clouds or foliage.

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Nicolas Le Sueur, after Sebastiano Conca
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two main figures with full bodies shown. The individual in the foreground is reclining with eyes closed, with their upper body bare and lower body covered by draped fabric. This person has long hair that cascades down their shoulders. Positioned behind them is a partially clothed individual who is sitting upright, with their head slightly tilted down towards the reclining person. The person has their hair styled in a wrapped or braided design. The clothing of both individuals resembles togas. The reclining person holds a long staff or spear. Around them on the ground are three dogs, with two lying down and one sitting upright looking up. Above the main figures are two cherubic figures with wings, one holding a torch, positioned among trees and foliage. The background consists of intricate detailing suggesting more trees and possibly a landscape in a line-drawing style.

artworks.title: L’École (The School)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after François Boucher, published by Pierre-François Basan
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic interior scene with children and a teacher. The image portrays a group within a room engaged in various activities. A seated adult figure appears to be teaching or showing something to a child standing in front of them, while another child stands nearby with a book or paper. Other children sit or kneel around them, possibly engaged in study or busy with books. The setting includes shelves containing books and pots, a window, and drapery hanging in the background. The arrangement of figures and detailed rendering of domestic objects and furnishings suggest a cozy atmosphere of education or domestic life.

artworks.title: Les Graces (The Graces)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after François Boucher, published by Pierre-François Basan
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three central full-body figures leaning and intertwined closely. Their hair is styled in updos with curls and waves framing their faces and necks. The artwork is monochrome, using shades of brown for shadows. Surrounding them are small winged cherubs or putti. The putti have round faces and chubby bodies, some interacting with the main figures. The central figures are not clothed and have no jewelry. The background has a swirling cloud-like texture, enhancing the ethereal and mythological theme.

artworks.title: Esquisse d’un tombeau (Sketch for a Tomb)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after François Boucher, published by Pierre-François Basan
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with classical elements. The artwork features a composition with a prominent urn on a pedestal. Surrounding the urn are figures, including mythological beings like angels or cherubs. There is a portrait of a woman in an oval medallion. The scene includes foliage and drapery, creating a sense of movement and a classical aesthetic. The drawing is monochromatic in shades of brown, giving it a historical feel.

artworks.title: The Tumble
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Jean Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene depicting a sudden event. The artwork portrays chaos with a wooden structure breaking apart on the right side. There is a burst of light emanating from the left side. In the center, two figures appear surprised or fearful, while another figure in the background gestures towards the scene. The painting uses a monochrome palette with shades of sepia, giving an aged, historical atmosphere to the scene.

artworks.title: Death of Archimedes
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Ciro Ferri
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a classical architectural setting. The composition features a kneeling figure being held by one armored figure while another armored figure reaches towards them. The background shows columns, arches, and sculptures. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette and hatching techniques to show depth and texture. The floor has checkered patterns, and a globe and an open book with geometric illustrations are in the foreground.

artworks.title: Le Triste Souvenir (The Sad Memory)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after François Boucher, published by Pierre-François Basan
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing together. In the center is a woman with her head tilted, hands clasped in front of her, and a solemn expression. She wears a long robe with a headscarf. Beside her is a child looking up at her with a hand on her arm. Behind them, another woman holds a cloth to her face. On the other side, a figure leans over an object resembling a crib. The background features abstract flowing lines and shaded areas, giving a natural setting impression. The image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Education of the Virgin
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after François Boucher
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with burnishing printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a sepia-toned scene. Two individuals are seated on a stone platform while the third person stands beside them. The seated figure on the left is a woman wearing a headscarf and a long garment. She leans towards a young girl beside her, who is listening intently. The person standing on the right is an older man in a long robe, engaging with them. The setting is outdoors under a large tree with foliage in the background. The scene is framed within an oval border with decorative motifs. Various items, including what appears to be a basket and a dog, are seen on the ground beside the stone structure.

artworks.title: Repos de Chasse (Rest from Hunting)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Jacob de Wit
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubs in a pastoral scene with hunting elements. The drawing depicts several cherubic figures engaging in playful activities amidst a nature setting. One cherub is climbing a tree, while others appear to be resting or interacting with each other. The idyllic scene suggests a moment of rest and play, with details such as a drum and the positioning of the cherubs conveying a sense of movement and liveliness. The artwork uses line and shading to define the forms of the cherubs and elements of nature, evoking a light-hearted and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Bacchanale
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Jacob de Wit
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures engaged in a playful gathering. The scene features several cherubic figures, some of which are seated while others stand, holding and seemingly distributing grapes among themselves. A goat is also present in the image, alongside a classical urn or vase in the background. Delicate foliage and leaves cascade from the top, framing the scene. The image's title is "Bacchanal." The figures are depicted in a light, whimsical manner with an expressive use of line to highlight movement and liveliness within the composition.

artworks.title: Le Jeune Astianax qu’Andromaque avoit caché dans le tombeau d’Hector est arraché des bras de sa Mere par les ordres d'Ulisse (Young Astianax, who Andromache Hid in Hector's Tomb, is Seized from his Mother's Arms by Ulysses' Orders)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Gabriel François Doyen
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting set in an architectural interior with figures in action. The composition includes strong gestures and emotional expressions amidst an atmosphere reminiscent of ancient Roman architecture, with arches and columns prominently visible. Soldiers in armor are present, engaged in physically commanding postures. The central focus is on the interaction between various figures, some in motion, others kneeling or gesturing expressively. The use of shadow and light gives depth to the architecture and a sense of three-dimensional space. Drapery and garments are rendered with attention to detail. The style is reminiscent of Jacques-Louis David, known for his neoclassical approach and historical themes.

artworks.title: Le Fermier brulé (A Burnt-Out Farmer, Begging with his Family)
artworks.artist: François-Philippe Charpentier, after Jean-Baptiste Greuze, published by Pierre-François Basan
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an interior setting. In the foreground, a woman is seated on the ground, holding an infant. Several children are close by, with some looking down. A man stands over them, extending his arm with an object. The background shows rough-textured walls of a building, with dim lighting casting deep shadows and highlights on the figures.

artworks.title: Les Fermiers brulés (A Burnt-Out Farmer, Begging with his Family)
artworks.artist: Ange-Laurent de Lalive de Jully, after Jean-Baptiste Greuze
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man leaning forward, reaching to the right, holding a hat and extending his arm. He has distinct facial features, wavy hair, and is wearing a dark jacket over a buttoned shirt. A woman is seated with her hands raised, a child clinging to her, another resting on her knee, and a third child seated beside her. They are dressed in loose, layered clothing. The background includes a stone wall, window, charred surfaces, and scattered objects.
